result.title: The SIMPLE Law for Energy Cost of LLM Inference
result.comment: Submitted to Future Generation Computer Systems
result.summary: Generative AI is billed per token, yet tokens are not equally expensive. Each token enters the KV-cache and raises the cost of those that follow, so energy grows non-linearly along a sequence whose tokens look identical. No analytical model states what a token costs, and the most accurate SOTA model is a fit, not a law: it absorbs architecture into fitted coefficients, requiring per-LLM fitting. We derive closed-form expressions of the computational and memory-access complexity of LLM inference in terms of architectural hyperparameters, covering MHA and GQA, and compare a family of analytical models of increasing granularity. From these, we obtain the SIMPLE Inference Model to Predict LLMs Energy (SIMPLE), a four-parameter law that separates prefill from decode, and decode into KV-cache cost and next-token computation. Over traces of 13 dense LLMs from six families on NVIDIA H100 GPUs, it attains R2 = 0.969 and 11.97% MAPE, 3.1-3.5x below the SOTA, without per-LLM calibration. The SIMPLE law explains as well as predicts: prefill energy grows quadratically with the hidden dimension, so larger LLMs suffer most from long inputs; and more aggressive GQA KV grouping reduces the per-token energy by up to 3x relative to standard MHA. Increasing the reasoning token budget pushes output length beyond the analytically derived energy minimum, driving super-linear energy growth; although accuracy grows with the budget, energy grows faster, so Intelligence per Joule peaks at an intermediate budget and falls by up to 3.14x across a 4.0x reasoning-budget range. Agentic serving raises energy per request by 13.0x relative to non-agentic ones, driven by the growth of both the prefill and the KV-cache terms with input length; while prefix caching removes most of the prefill cost (-93%), the KV-cache term is unaffected, so even a cached agentic request costs 4.8x more.

AI.brief_summary: 论文从架构超参数推导 LLM 推理的计算与访存复杂度闭式表达（含 MHA/GQA），提出四参数 SIMPLE 律，把 prefill 与 decode（再分为 KV-cache 与下一 token 计算）拆开建模，在 H100 上跨 13 个密集 LLM 免逐模型校准达到 R²=0.969，并据此分析推理预算与能耗、准确率的权衡。
AI.relevance_reason: 提供以 token 与 KV-cache 为单位的解析能耗成本项和「预算—收益」曲线，可供核查 THINK/STOP 停止决策与动态计算的成本收益；但它是纯文本、单次前向能耗规律，能否覆盖视觉 token 与 latent 状态的开销尚需核查。
